$comment: Per-page budgets from docs-redesign Stage 2 (engineering-constraints.md, section 2). Sizes are gzip (level 6) kilobytes (1 KB = 1024 bytes) of what a page loads on first visit, excluding on-demand search (Pagefind). Page types are matched by path in order; the last rule with no 'match' is the default.

thirdParty.$comment: Hosts a page may load from. Anything else fails. Stage 2 policy: no third-party request on page load except the Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon, which is injected at the edge and not in dist/.

allow.reason: Known exception: Mermaid 11.17.2, loaded by the head script in astro.config.mjs. Remove this entry when Mermaid is replaced by build-time diagrams (redesign build step 2).
